# Fixtures

Fixture tables built byte by byte live in `../vfp-reader.Tests/Fixtures/DbfBuilder.cs`, so each
format rule is pinned by code rather than by an opaque binary.

This directory is for small real tables copied from other MIT-licensed projects (for example
FoxDevStudio's samples), which the testing plan calls for in item 2. Nothing is committed here
yet because each sample needs a license-compatibility pass first.
